Jenna: Quick check 1 — thinking of two totally different saturday vibes: sunrise lighthouse photo walk (meet 6:15am, bring coffee & tripod) or a relaxed pottery glaze party at my place in the afternoon (well fire pieces next week). Which are you leaning toward? :camera_with_flash: :tea:
Omar: Lighthouse walk sounds peak. Im trying to actually use my camera this year. 6:15 is early but worth it.
Li: Id do pottery no early alarm pls also I can bring extra glazes (blue/amber).
Tom: Photo walk for me I need landscape practice. Will anyone bring a monopod?
Noor: Pottery party! Ill bring vinyl and biscuits. Afternoon is perfect after my morning yoga.
Jenna: Awesome. Quick run-down: reply "photo" or "pottery". If more photo people, well do lighthouse + coffee; if pottery wins, afternoon shift at my place 2-5pm. No drama.
Omar: photo
Tom: photo
Li: pottery
Noor: pottery
Jenna: tally photo: Omar, Tom (2). pottery: Li, Noor (2). Looks tied. I can do pottery either way but lighthouse needs a firm count for parking at the lighthouse lot. Ill flip a coin or if it's still tied at 5pm today Ill choose lighthouse for the sunrise crowd and well run pottery as a backup Sunday PM.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: communal tea stock low. If pottery wins, someone please pick up black tea & chamomile before Saturday :tea: (checkout list: /ops/kitchen).
Jenna: Cool Ill DM the small group with details once I decide. If youre on either list and then need to opt-out, post here and Ill update. Also if anyone has a spare tripod or a rental suggestion, ping me.
